relationships.subject: retigabine
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with the K<sub>V</sub>7 channel opener retigabine blunted the colonic afferent response to all applied stimuli.

relationships.subject: retigabine
relationships.evidence_quote: Unlike SKA-31, retigabine pretreatment before the fourth bradykinin application inhibited the response to bradykinin

relationships.subject: SKA-31
relationships.evidence_quote: Despite this, pretreatment with the dual SK/IK channel opener SKA-31 had no effect on the colonic afferent response to ATP, bradykinin, or noxious ramp distention of the colon.

relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: Both ATP and bradykinin evoke action potential firing through multiple mechanisms, including the inhibition of KV7 channels in a phospholipase C- (PLC) dependent manner (21, 22).

key_findings: KV7 opener retigabine, but not SK/IK opener SKA-31, inhibited colonic afferent responses to ATP, bradykinin and distension.
